ideas.title: FTC: X account pitches Filtronic as Starlink infrastructure play
ideas.summary: An X-account (author 1425501982320701442) highlights Filtronic ($FTC, UK-listed) as a direct beneficiary of Starlink's aviation expansion — Starlink just signed 3 of the 4 largest US airlines covering 2,300+ aircraft. Filtronic supplies E-band GaN amplifiers for Starlink's RF infrastructure, has cumulative contracts exceeding $115M (including a $62.5M deal signed August 2025), and SpaceX holds warrants over 15% of Filtronic shares.

ideas.title: XFAB: X account pitches photonics/power semi name at $1.28B MC
ideas.summary: Author 1940360837547565056 flags X-FAB Silicon Foundries ($XFAB) as an interesting long at a $1.28B market cap, citing exposure to photonics and power semiconductors as compelling. No specific price target was provided, but the poster indicates active monitoring of several developments within the company.
